summary_en: The Hyakujushi Bank authorized acquisition of up to 2.0 million shares (1.8% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥3.0 billion from November 11, 2026 to March 24, 2027 via market purchase to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
The Hyakujushi Bank's board of directors resolved on November 10, 2026 to acquire treasury stock pursuant to Article 156 of the Companies Act as applied by Article 165(3). The company will acquire up to 2.0 million ordinary shares, representing 1.8% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum total of ¥3.0 billion. The acquisition period runs from November 11, 2026 through March 24, 2027.

The stated purposes are to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 945,606 treasury shares against 113.57 million issued shares excluding treasury stock. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
